scientific.integrity: The preservation lemma and infinite family are proved symbolically. The bundled program is a finite regression check only.
scientific.limitations: The leaf-extension lemma is general, but the explicit Hu--Wen corollary excludes characteristic 2. No classification is claimed. Barei 2026 remarks that a different seed extends to all dimensions but does not state the structural preservation properties claimed here.

title: Leaf extensions preserve connected idempotent-free nonsolvability in evolution algebras
